capabilities.name: Deterministic project core and packaging
capabilities.entry_point: uriel start / uriel verify / uriel doctor
capabilities.notes: Offline-first project confinement, content-addressed records, receipts, and zero runtime dependencies.

capabilities.name: Data Readiness and Gate 0
capabilities.notes: Exact active-generation identity, deterministic v2 SortSpecs and readiness receipts, stale/tamper invalidation, strict Gate 0 interlock, and bounded no-authority AI projections.

capabilities.name: Three Integrity Gates
capabilities.notes: Scope and claim language, direct evidence, and adversarial robustness with fail-closed repair guidance.

capabilities.name: Strict Blessing and independent verifier
capabilities.notes: Content-addressed attestation of recorded gate decisions and exact bound artifacts; not independent scientific validation.

capabilities.name: Research lifecycle, workbench, repair, and submission
capabilities.entry_point: uriel intake / uriel workbench / uriel burst / uriel submit
capabilities.notes: Question intake, bounded review packets, gap records, repair packets, decisions, and submission support.

capabilities.name: Assurance depth, evidence microscope, and decision card
capabilities.notes: Exploratory assurance chains, evidence-strength records, and decision artifacts; no dedicated CLI contract yet.

capabilities.name: Bounded advisory AI handoff and review import
capabilities.entry_point: uriel prompt / uriel assist / uriel review-import
capabilities.notes: Metadata-only nonpublic defaults, 128-KiB prompt/review ceilings, exact hash-bound import, and an explicitly acknowledged bounded external-process adapter. The adapter is not an OS sandbox and no AI output has gate, publication, or Blessing authority.

capabilities.name: Synthetic Forge Trial fixture and adjudicated scorer
capabilities.notes: Validates the sealed synthetic fixture and scores supplied adjudicated findings; it does not claim a detector was run.

capabilities.name: Evidence ingress and Data Desk
capabilities.entry_point: uriel data plan / import / inspect / diff / reconcile / verify-generation
capabilities.notes: Bounded local immutable intake, structural generations, preserve-all reconciliation, and deep verification, with a measured synthetic receipt and installed-wheel exercise. Data commands alone grant no scientific or Gate 0 authority; only the separate exact v2 readiness lane can pass the bound generation into Gate 0.

capabilities.name: Operational Forge Method closure engine
capabilities.notes: The Forge of Uriel is the public identity. Additive v1 run and sanitized-export contracts are frozen and compatibility-tested, but no Forge persistence, transition, verification, export, or automatic milestone-closure engine is implemented.

capabilities.name: Built-in local-model adapter
capabilities.notes: External and local models can consume bounded prompts today; Uriel does not ship an inference provider.

capabilities.name: Desktop GUI and native installer
capabilities.notes: The supported product is currently CLI/Python-first.
